description: This file defines the internal sealed partial class 'ConnectionManager' responsible for managing network connections in Orleans Runtime. It handles connection lifecycle events such as establishing, terminating, and retries, and maintains connection state per silo address.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network connections, including establishing, reconnecting, and shutting down connections for Orleans silos. Handles connection retries and maintains connection state per endpoint.

classes.name: ConnectionEntry
classes.description: Represents a set of connections and related state information for a specific silo endpoint, including pending connection attempts and last failure time.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: Returns an existing connection to a specified endpoint if available, initiating a new connection asynchronously if needed.

methods.name: TryGetConnection
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a current active connection for a specified endpoint.

methods.name: CloseAsync
methods.description: Closes all connections associated with a specified endpoint.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the connection manager, closing all active connections and canceling pending attempts.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Handles logic after a successful connection, updating connection state and logging.

methods.name: OnConnectionTerminated
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a connection is terminated, removing it from state and logging.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Attempts to establish a new connection to a specified endpoint, handling retries and exceptions.

methods.name: RunConnectionAsync
methods.description: Runs a connection asynchronously, managing its lifecycle and handling errors.

methods.name: StartConnection
methods.description: Queues a background task to run the connection's lifecycle.

methods.name: GetOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a connection entry for a particular silo endpoint.
